archetypes.name: dyn-ci-fixer-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 8 now relies on prose-driven durable handoff sequencing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed Step 8 CI-fixer documentation and harness pins. Focus on whether the kill switch, pre-spawn digest, no-respawn guard, success handoff, and post-bail fallback are internally consistent and match the Python route-exit behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
